title: AKS Confidential VMs: Azure Linux 3 Deployment and Honest Upgrade Evidence
summary: Understand the node-level trust boundary, placement, cost, SKU and quota checks, storage and maintenance limitations, and an Ubuntu 24.04 CVM upgrade observation with a sanitized shutdown-test manifest.
sourceDocuments: AKS Azure Linux 3 Confidential VM: Benefits, Considerations, Regions, and Deployment Guide
Confidential VM Graceful Shutdown Observation Sample

downloads.label: Download the CVM shutdown observation YAML
downloads.description: Lab-only Namespace, Python ConfigMap, and three single-replica Deployments. Replace every REPLACE_WITH_CVM_POOL selector before use. No Service, PDB, preStop hook, or high-availability guarantee.

omissions: Private repository links, source screenshots, raw observation logs, kubeconfig, subscription and tenant identifiers, resource identifiers, customer names, hostnames, IP addresses, personal paths, and contact information are not published.
Subscription-specific quota inventory, quota-request outcomes, support case details, and support status are replaced with anonymous decision examples, not current account records.
Internal, early-access, and staging region names are not published as deployment candidates.
No shutdown-duration, exit-code, SIGKILL, request-loss, latency, pricing, or availability measurements are invented: the source did not establish them.

The sample retains its image and application behavior; only pool selectors and English safety notes differ. No Service, PDB, preStop hook, traffic generator, production scheduling change, or privileged test has been added.
The recorded upgrade used Ubuntu 24.04, not Azure Linux 3. Azure Linux 3 provisioning and the Ephemeral OS Disk alternatives are guidance, not newly executed validation.

Current public DCasv6 Ephemeral OS Disk support conflicts with the source AKS capability response; the article exposes this unresolved discrepancy rather than declaring universal support or non-support. The v6 memory-preserving maintenance discrepancy likewise remains unresolved.
The broad one-subscription region inventory is condensed into dated public-region examples and repeatable discovery, not republished as a current availability matrix.
